edits.value_json: "Ada swung open the garden gate and lifted the lamp. She wanted a grand parade of shadows, while Bo prepared a moonflower welcome for their shy visitor. Somewhere in the dark garden, Pip waited for an invitation gentle enough to follow."
"Ada opened the gate with a flourish. \u201cTonight, a moon performance!\u201d she announced. Bo held up one quiet finger and prepared a soft-bell invitation. Somewhere nearby, a tiny moth listened."

"The gate creaked open beneath the rising moon. Ada had planned a still paper-moon tableau, while Bo prepared a flowery welcome. They hoped their hidden guest would come close. Pip folded its wings and waited."
"Ada opened the garden gate and bowed to the dark. \u201cMy paper moon is ready!\u201d she said. Bo kept a silver bell nearby for a quiet invitation. The shy moth waited somewhere in the garden."
"Ada hurried to Bo. \u201cPip is hiding under the leaves,\u201d she said. Bo leaned closer, suddenly very interested in the quiet places."
